en: A sepia-toned postcard featuring a film still of a man resembling Charlie Chaplin's Tramp character standing in a shabby alley or courtyard with worn walls and doors. He wears a bowler hat, mustache, and ill‑fitting clothes. A sleeping person lies on a bed or makeshift cot behind him. The lower border contains printed text in German identifying the actor and film title, along with a small publisher/series imprint.
